description: Refactor CrawlExecutionService (1656 lines, 80+ methods) into 4 focused services following Single Responsibility Principle
approach: Extract cohesive method groups into dedicated services: CrawlOptionsNormalizer (all normalize* methods), CrawlPayloadParser (all parse* methods), CrawlResultPartitioner (result classification), and CrawlNotificationService (notification handling). Keep CrawlExecutionService as thin orchestrator for task execution.
